summary.headline: Anand Rathi Wealth FY26 PAT rose 28% to INR 386 crores (excluding fair value and ESOP items); FY27 PAT guidance INR 460 crores.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 underlying (ex fair value gain, ESOP and tax effects) total revenue rose 25% YoY to INR 302 crores and PAT rose 25% to INR 92 crores, with PAT margin flat at 30.5%. FY26 underlying revenue grew 22% to INR 1,198 crores and PAT grew 28% to INR 386 crores, with margin up from 30.7% to 32.2%. AUM crossed INR 1 lakh crore on the call date, and the Board approved a 1:1 bonus and a final dividend of INR 7 per share, both subject to shareholder approval. Reported figures were higher due to a INR 54.6 crore fair value gain on the ARGFL stake and a INR 39.3 crore ESOP charge.

segments.commentary: Net addition of 1,600 client families in the last 12 months, taking the total to 13,395 individual families. Relationship managers number about 401 per a later remark. Platinum segment (large-ticket clients) grew to about 211 families from 32-33 at launch, with a 450-500 target in two years.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue guidance INR 1,415 crores (underlying basis).
FY27 PAT guidance INR 460 crores, excluding ESOP and fair value effects; about 18-19% growth on FY26 base of INR 386 crores, about 22% on the INR 375 crores FY26 guidance.
Management reiterated a long-term 20-25% PAT growth range.
Management said the trail yield impact from the SEBI TER change is not material, at roughly 2-4 bps on a 1.09% base.
Branch expansion is being considered, opened only where a local RM can be sent back; no new branches opened in Q4.
capex_capacity: No new branches opened in Q4 FY26 (confirmed by CFO); further branch openings under consideration, owned rather than franchised.
RM headcount at about 401 per Q&A, with 45 RMs added in the year, 78% of them trained from colleges.
Q4 gross MLD issuance INR 1,895 crores (vs INR 1,815 crores in Q3); secondary INR 1,101 crores (vs INR 716 crores in Q3).
Third-party product sales INR 168 crores in Q4 (vs INR 213 crores in Q3).
demand_pricing: Q4 net inflows about INR 3,379 crores, per the Q&A; management declined to disclose the quarterly figure in the prepared remarks. A promoter-linked inflow of over INR 1,000 crores was excluded from net flows.
Management expects trail/distribution squeeze of about 2-4 bps at most; AMCs are seeking negotiations, but impact considered not material.
Trail income is about 40% of revenue per management; about 99% of structured products carry rollover options.
ESOP: INR 39.3 crore charge in Q4 for grants at face value under the 2018 ESOP policy, mainly to the joint CEO and CFO per management.

qa_highlights.question: Quantum and valuation of the ARGFL rights issue subscription, and the asset sale driving other income?
qa_highlights.answer: ARGFL rights issue total INR 512 crores at INR 500 per share; Anand Rathi Wealth subscribed about INR 40 crores to hold its roughly 8% stake. The INR 54.6 crore gain is a mark-to-market fair value change, with no shares sold.

qa_highlights.question: ESOP at face value versus CMP, and who receives it?
qa_highlights.answer: ESOPs are granted at face value under the 2018 policy, so the gap to market price is expensed (INR 39.3 crores in Q4). Management said the grants are concentrated in the KMP (joint CEO and CFO). The analyst remained unconvinced on the one-off classification.

qa_highlights.question: Why is FY27 PAT growth guidance (18-19%) below the 20-25% range?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the 18-19% was a rounded figure and that on the FY26 guidance base of INR 375 crores the growth is about 22%, within the 20-25% range. It said guidance is set to under-commit.

qa_highlights.question: Outlook on net inflows after 7% growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said 7% was not a cause for celebration but was satisfactory, and cited market conditions. It noted the industry's equity active funds had net negative flows ex-SIP in the prior month.

qa_highlights.question: Impact of SEBI's new TER structure on trail yields?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said AMCs are seeking distributor negotiations, but the impact of 2-4 bps on a 1.09% yield is not significant and does not threaten PAT growth over the next 4-5 years.

qa_highlights.question: Attrition rise in FY26 and impact on business?
qa_highlights.answer: Seven RMs left in FY26 with INR 1,212 crores AUM on resignation; INR 987 crores (81%) was retained with the same families, against 69% retention for the two FY25 exits. Management described it as a one-off.

risks_watch: Trail yield compression from SEBI TER rules and AMC negotiations, though management sees only a 2-4 bps impact.
ESOP expense on face-value grants (INR 39.3 crores in Q4) continues to weigh on reported PAT; future ESOP trajectory was not quantified.
Net flows growth of 7% is modest; management acknowledged market-dependent flows.
ARGFL valuation: the fair value gain is a mark-to-market gain on an unlisted NBFC; the March balance sheet was not finalised on the call.
Client attrition at 0.54% of AUM and the RM attrition trend warrant tracking.
summary.management_tone: Confident and expansive on the results and franchise moat, with stated caution on FY27 guidance (framed as under-commit and over-deliver). Evasive on ESOP pricing and on the ARGFL financials, where analysts were referred offline.
key_quotes: It's not a capital race. It's a credibility marathon.
So 7% is nothing the ride home about, but I'm very happy that we bought equity in the last quarter where everybody was so depressed.

growth.why: FY27 revenue guided at INR 1,415 crores (about 18% over FY26 underlying INR 1,198 crores, growth rate derived) and PAT at INR 460 crores, backed mainly by client additions, AUM target of INR 1,20,000 crores and Platinum segment growth, with no specific capacity or order numbers; branch expansion only under consideration and none opened in Q4.
